title: 第1章 恶毒女配自救系统已激活第2章 登仙试炼
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 大夏王朝的皇宫深处，金碧辉煌的殿宇在晨光中熠熠生辉。
三岁的林枝意被皇帝爹爹稳稳抱在怀中，一身精致繁复的宫装衬得她粉雕玉琢的小脸越发可爱。
她眨巴着圆溜溜的大眼睛，好奇地打量着四周，小小的手指缠绕着衣角，浑然不知今日将是她与父母分别的日子。
【叮——恶毒女配自救系统已激活，正在绑定宿主】
一道机械音突兀地在林枝意脑海中响起，她困惑地歪了歪小脑袋，大眼睛里满是不解。
“唔？”她含糊地发出一个音节，引得皇帝林宸渊低头温柔地看向她。
“小枝意说什么呢？”皇帝用胡茬轻轻蹭了蹭女儿娇嫩的小脸，惹得她咯咯直笑。
【绑定成功！宿主林枝意，大夏王朝公主，原著中未来将成为男女主爱情路上的恶毒女配，下场凄惨。本系统将协助宿主改变命运，请宿主积极配合】
林枝意粉嫩的小嘴微微嘟起，眉头皱成一团“？听不懂～”
系统似乎被这反应噎住了，机械音里透出一丝无奈，“简单说，如果枝意不努力，以后会变得很惨很惨哦。”
“不要惨惨！”林枝意的小脸顿时垮了下来，眼圈微红，一副马上就要哭出来的样子。
“别别别！”
系统慌了神，连忙转换语气，“枝意乖乖，不难过，系统会帮你的。你看，前面有好吃的糖糖哦～”
听到“糖糖”，林枝意立刻破涕为笑，小脑袋点得像小鸡啄米。
一旁的皇后苏云卿见状，忍不住伸手轻轻捏了捏女儿的小脸“我们枝意今天怎么一会儿哭一会儿笑的？”
林宸渊将女儿搂得更紧了些，语气低沉
“国师说枝意命中有此仙缘，若强留宫中，反而会折损她的福运。只是这一去怕是此生再难相见了。”
苏云卿眼中泛起泪光，强忍着不舍“陛下，修仙之路漫长，枝意才三岁，她”
“朕知道。”林宸渊闭了闭眼，“所以朕已命人备足了灵丹妙药、护身法宝，定要保她平安无忧。”
皇宫外，皇家车队浩浩荡荡驶向登仙山。
林枝意被父母紧紧护在中间，一路上好奇地张望着窗外风景。
【枝意，记住系统的话，等会儿到了登仙山，要乖乖的，不要乱跑，知道吗？】
“枝意乖乖！”小女孩自豪地拍了拍小胸脯，引得父母相视而笑。
抵达山脚时，已有数百名年龄不等的孩童聚集在那里。
他们大多衣着朴素，只有少数几个看起来家境尚可。
当皇家车队抵达时，所有目光都聚焦过来，窃窃私语声不绝于耳。
“那就是大夏王朝的小公主？”
“听说才三岁，这么小就来求仙缘？”
“看她那一身，肯定很贵吧”
林宸渊亲自将女儿抱下车，苏云卿细心地为她整理衣襟。
林枝意刚被换上的是一件流光溢彩的护身法衣，腰间挂着装满灵药的储物袋，头上别着防御发簪，全身上下无不是皇室精心准备的宝物。
“枝意，记住爹爹的话，”林宸渊蹲下身，与女儿平视，
“上山后要听仙长的话，不要轻易相信陌生人，遇到危险就用爹爹给你的法宝，知道吗？”
苏云卿忍不住将女儿搂入怀中，声音哽咽“我的枝意一定要平安”
小公主似懂非懂地点点头，伸出小手擦去母亲脸上的泪水“阿娘不哭，枝意会乖乖。”
content_en:
Deep in the imperial palace of the Great Xia Dynasty, the magnificent palaces shone in the morning light.
Three-year-old Lin Zhiyi was held firmly in the arms of the emperor's father. Her exquisite and complicated palace clothes made her little face even more cute.
She blinked her big round eyes and looked around curiously. Her little fingers were wrapped around the corners of her clothes. She had no idea that today would be the day she and her parents parted ways.
[Ding—The vicious female partner’s self-rescue system has been activated and is binding to the host]
A mechanical sound suddenly sounded in Lin Zhiyi's mind. She tilted her head in confusion, her big eyes full of confusion.
"Huh?" She uttered a syllable vaguely, causing Emperor Lin Chenyuan to lower his head and look at her tenderly.
"What did Xiao Zhiyi say?" The emperor gently rubbed his daughter's delicate face with his stubble, making her giggle.
[Binding successful! The host, Lin Zhiyi, is a princess of the Great Xia Dynasty. In the original work, she will become a vicious female partner on the road to love between the male and female protagonists, and she will end up miserable. This system will help the host change its destiny, so the host is requested to actively cooperate]
Lin Zhiyi's pink little mouth pouted slightly and her brows knitted into a ball, "? Don't you understand~"
"Uh"
The system seemed to be choked by this reaction, and there was a trace of helplessness in the mechanical voice, "To put it simply, if Zhiyi doesn't work hard, it will become very miserable in the future."
"Don't be miserable!" Lin Zhiyi's little face suddenly fell down, her eyes were slightly red, and she looked like she was about to cry.
"No, no, no!"
The system panicked and quickly changed its tone, "Zhiyi, be good, don't be sad, the system will help you. Look, there are delicious candies ahead~"
When Lin Zhiyi heard "Tangtang", she immediately burst into tears and smiled, her little head nodding like a chicken pecking at rice.
When Queen Su Yunqing saw this, she couldn't help but reached out and pinched her daughter's face gently, "Why are we, Zhiyi, crying and laughing today?"
Lin Chenyuan hugged his daughter tighter and spoke in a low tone.
"The Imperial Master said that Zhiyi is destined to have such an immortal destiny. If she is forced to stay in the palace, it will damage her luck. But if she leaves, I'm afraid it will be difficult to see her again in this life."
Tears filled Su Yunqing's eyes, and she held back her reluctance: "Your Majesty, the road to immortality is long, Zhiyi is only three years old, she"
"I know." Lin Chenyuan closed his eyes, "So I have ordered people to prepare enough elixirs and protective magic weapons to keep her safe and sound."
Outside the palace, the royal motorcade drove toward Dengxian Mountain.
Lin Zhiyi was closely protected by her parents, looking curiously at the scenery outside the window along the way.
[Zhiyi, if you remember the system, when you get to Dengxian Mountain later, be obedient and don't run around, you know? 】
"Zhiyi is good!" The little girl patted her chest proudly, causing her parents to look at each other and smile.
When we arrived at the foot of the mountain, hundreds of children of various ages had gathered there.
Most of them were simply dressed, and only a few of them seemed to be from reasonably well-off families.
When the royal motorcade arrived, all eyes were on it and whispers could be heard.
"Is that the little princess of the Great Xia Dynasty?"
"I heard that you are only three years old. Are you here to seek immortality at such a young age?"
"Looking at her outfit, it must be very expensive."
Lin Chenyuan personally carried his daughter out of the car, and Su Yunqing carefully arranged her clothes.
What Lin Zhiyi had just been put on was a gleaming protective robe, with a storage bag filled with elixirs hanging around her waist, and a defensive hairpin on her head. Every part of her body was a treasure carefully prepared by the royal family.
"Zhiyi, remember what dad said," Lin Chenyuan knelt down and looked level with his daughter,
"When you go up the mountain, listen to the immortals' words. Don't trust strangers easily. If you encounter danger, use the magic weapon daddy gave you. Do you understand?"
Su Yunqing couldn't help but hugged her daughter into her arms, her voice choked with sobs, "My branches must be safe."
The little princess nodded as if she understood, and stretched out her little hand to wipe away the tears on her mother's face. "If Mom doesn't cry, Zhiyi will be obedient."
title_en: Chapter 1 The vicious female supporting character’s self-rescue system has been activated Chapter 2 The test of ascending to immortality
